sections.title: Kind words from people I have worked with

paragraphs: I am a Full Stack Software Engineer delivering scalable enterprise solutions across fintech, banking and tax compliance for clients including USAA and Vertex Inc. I bring end-to-end SDLC expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, microservices, AWS and Azure, combined with hands-on experience developing AI agents and integrating multiple LLMs.

I use Claude, Specification-Driven Development (SDD) and Research, Plan, and Implement (RPI) methodologies to accelerate delivery. I have contributed to DevOps, Center of Excellence (CoE) and Vertex Agent Platform (VAPOR) initiatives spanning engineering improvements, enterprise metrics and application delivery, with recognition for innovation, internal platform development and multiple hackathon wins.

bullets: Designed and developed AI-powered engineering agents, including PR Fix and Fail-to-Fix agents, integrating multiple LLMs to automate development workflows, code analysis and issue resolution; collaborated with the VAPOR (Vertex Agent Platform) team to build cluster-based AI agents for end users.

Built TechScout, an end-to-end application using React.js and Node.js, contributing to frontend development, backend services, API integration and delivery; also enhanced the Connected Tax Platform (CTP) with application features, chat-based interfaces and AI-agent capabilities.

Contributed to Center of Excellence (CoE) initiatives by developing reusable skills, commands and AI agents that standardized workflows and improved developer productivity; collaborated across AI engineering, DevOps, CoE and platform development teams on organization-wide solutions and engineering practices.

Contributed to the Vertex Unified Metrics Platform to support centralized, consistent engineering measurement, while supporting DevOps and deployment workflows, including n8n deployments and automation that streamlined delivery and operations.

Applied Specification-Driven Development (SDD) and Research, Plan, and Implement (RPI) methodologies with Claude to structure requirements, plan implementations and accelerate AI-assisted software delivery.

Developed an in-house quiz application as an alternative to third-party solutions, earning organizational recognition and prize money. Also achieved multiple hackathon wins through innovative application development and AI-driven solutions.

Developed and maintained enterprise engineering applications using Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data JPA, RESTful Web Services and microservices across banking, insurance and enterprise-security projects for USAA and Citi Bank.

Contributed to USAA's Classic to Talon Migration (C2T) by analyzing legacy integrations, designing as-is and to-be API flows and developing migration strategies; designed, documented and published REST APIs using OpenAPI and Swagger 2.0 to improve discoverability and developer onboarding.

Integrated downstream APIs for secure microservice communication, optimized SQL queries and database operations, and implemented unit tests using JUnit and Mockito, achieving 85%+ test coverage and helping reduce production defects.

Deployed and monitored applications on OpenShift, analyzed pod logs through the OpenShift Web UI, and used Kibana and Elasticsearch to investigate application behavior, traffic patterns, active server instances and production issues.

Contributed to Citi Bank's Service Account Migration (SAM) by migrating service accounts to CyberArk, implementing secure integrations with Core Java and Spring Boot, and decommissioning deprecated accounts to strengthen credential security and reduce attack surface.

work.title: PR Fix Agent
work.text: An automated code reviewer for pull requests. When a developer opens or updates a pull request, the agent reviews the changes, looks for bugs, security risks and quality problems, and posts clear feedback with suggested fixes and examples directly on the pull request. It works like a reviewer who is always available.
work.result: Developers get feedback on bugs and security issues before a human review starts.

work.title: Fail-to-Fix Agent
work.text: When an automated test run fails, this agent reads the test results, finds what failed and suggests fixes. It uses earlier fix attempts as context, so suggestions for similar failures can build on what worked before, and it posts them on the pull request as a clear review comment.
work.result: Gives developers a starting point for fixing failed tests right where they already work.

work.title: Vertex Agent Platform (VAPOR)
work.text: An internal platform where teams build, run and manage AI agents in one place. It provides the agent runtime, an approved catalog of models and tools, safety guardrails, a readiness check before release, and monitoring of every run. Teams bring their own use case and data, and the platform handles the rest.
work.role: Built AI agents together with the platform team
work.result: Teams can move from an idea to a working, governed agent without building all the infrastructure themselves.

work.title: TechScout
work.text: A self-service web application where employees request new technologies and follow the request until it is approved or rejected. Each request moves through clear steps such as submission, review, evaluation and decision, with the right people involved at each step. It replaces scattered ticket tracking with one simple, visible workflow. I worked on the frontend, backend services, API integration and delivery.
work.role: Full stack developer: frontend, backend services and delivery
work.result: Everyone can see where a request stands, and reviewers get one clear place to work.

work.title: Connected Tax Platform
work.text: A web platform that brings tax products together into one connected experience. Instead of moving between separate products, customers follow their everyday tax tasks from start to finish in one place, with a single entry page, clear navigation, dashboards, a chat assistant and AI-agent help. I added application features, chat-based interfaces and AI-agent capabilities.
work.role: Built features across the user interface and AI-agent integration
work.result: Customers get one clear place to work, with AI help next to their tasks.

work.title: Vertex Unified Metrics Platform
work.text: A shared way to measure how products and engineering are doing. Instead of every team counting things in its own way, the platform collects measurements such as product usage, delivery speed, testing status and service health in one place, using common definitions, and shows them in dashboards that leaders and teams can both read. I contributed to it, along with DevOps work and deployment automation.
work.role: Contributed to the platform, and to DevOps and deployment automation
work.result: Teams and leaders look at the same numbers, defined in the same way.
